capabilities: Export a story note to Shunn standard manuscript format as .docx or .rtf
Apply typographic cleanup such as curly quotes, em dashes and ellipses
Produce blind submissions with anonymous or identified cover page configurations
Save and apply export profiles for markets with unusual requirements
Create story notes with title and content warning properties
disambiguation: Not a general document exporter; it only produces Shunn standard manuscript format files, and a story must be a single note.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later; works on desktop and mobile; never connects to the internet; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a markdown story into the manuscript format editors and markets expect for submissions.
summary: Export tool that converts a story note into Shunn's standard manuscript format as a .docx or .rtf, ready to submit to markets.
